entry.title: How Fibo lets Claude Code on the other end of ssh take a pasted screenshot
entry.summary: Over ssh, Claude Code reads the clipboard of the computer it runs on, so a pasted screenshot never arrives. After testing 20 kinds of paste: a paste that is only one absolute image path becomes an attachment. Fibo saves the picture on that computer, then pastes only the path. With a manual recipe and the test table.

entry.title: One Window for Terminals on Every Machine: Fibo’s Multi-Host Architecture and Slow-Link Sync Design
entry.summary: How Fibo lets one desktop window operate terminals across multiple machines: why we dropped our separate remote UI, how one ssh -L socket tunnel unified 85 native RPCs, how we decoupled per-window view chrome from per-host state, and how we shrank refreshes from 3.59 MB to 660 bytes on a 54 KB/s link.
